notes: Extends existing 30-scene Genesis word-connect Story mechanic; stable 10 discovery IDs, normal points/hints/saves; no new mode.

g10-d01.clue: After Abraham died, which son did Jehovah continue to bless?
g10-d01.explanation: Genesis 25:11 says God continued to bless Isaac after Abraham's death.
g10-d01.hint1: Both Isaac and Ishmael buried Abraham.
g10-d01.hint2: Genesis 25:11 names the son Jehovah blessed afterward.

g10-d02.clue: What were the two children Rebekah was expecting?
g10-d02.explanation: Genesis 25:21–26 explains Rebekah's pregnancy and the birth of Esau and Jacob.
g10-d02.hint1: Jehovah spoke of two nations inside Rebekah.
g10-d02.hint2: Two brothers were born from the same pregnancy.

g10-d03.clue: What was Esau especially skilled at doing in the field?
g10-d03.explanation: Genesis 25:27 describes Esau as a skilled hunter and Jacob as a blameless man dwelling in tents.
g10-d03.hint1: He spent much of his time out in the field.
g10-d03.hint2: He was known for catching game.

g10-d04.clue: What kind of stew did Esau receive after selling his birthright?
g10-d04.explanation: Genesis 25:29–34 tells how Esau sold his birthright to Jacob, then ate bread and lentil stew.
g10-d04.hint1: This meal was made from a small edible seed.
g10-d04.hint2: Genesis 25:34 specifically describes the stew's main ingredient.

g10-d05.clue: Where did Isaac settle when Jehovah told him not to go down to Egypt?
g10-d05.explanation: During a famine, Isaac went to Gerar. Jehovah instructed him not to go to Egypt and confirmed his promise. (Genesis 26:1–6)
g10-d05.hint1: It was a place associated with King Abimelech.

g10-d06.clue: What did Isaac name the well where his servants no longer faced a dispute?
g10-d06.explanation: Isaac named the well Rehoboth, saying Jehovah had made ample room for his household. (Genesis 26:22)
g10-d06.hint1: The name points to having room to spread out.
g10-d06.hint2: Look at the name given in Genesis 26:22.

g10-d07.clue: What did Isaac and Abimelech make to seal their peaceful agreement?
g10-d07.explanation: Genesis 26:26–31 describes Abimelech's visit, their agreement, and the oath they exchanged.
g10-d07.hint1: It's a solemn promise between people.
g10-d07.hint2: Genesis 26:31 says they swore this to one another.

g10-d08.clue: What did Rebekah place on Jacob's hands so they would feel hairy?
g10-d08.explanation: Genesis 27:16 describes Rebekah covering Jacob's hands and smooth neck with the skins of young goats as part of the deception.
g10-d08.hint1: They came from young animals prepared for the meal.
g10-d08.hint2: Genesis 27:16 tells what covered Jacob's hands.

g10-d09.clue: What did Isaac give Jacob when he believed he was speaking to Esau?
g10-d09.explanation: Isaac gave Jacob the blessing after Jacob falsely said he was Esau. Esau returned afterward and was distressed. (Genesis 27:18–38)
g10-d09.hint1: It was something Isaac had intended to give Esau.

g10-d10.clue: What did Jacob name the place where he dreamed about a stairway?
g10-d10.explanation: After the dream, Jacob set up the stone as a pillar and named the place Bethel. (Genesis 28:10–22)
